verses.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我投靠你；求你叫我永不羞愧！

verses.text: In Your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; Incline Your ear to me and save me.
verses.textZh: 求你憑你的公義搭救我，救拔我；側耳聽我，拯救我！

verses.text: Be to me a rock of habitation to which I may continually come; You have given commandment to save me, For You are my rock and my fortress.
verses.textZh: 求你作我常住的磐石；你已經命定要救我，因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨。

verses.text: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the grasp of the wrongdoer and ruthless man,
verses.textZh: 我的神啊，求你救我脫離惡人的手，脫離不義和殘暴之人的手。

verses.text: For You are my hope; O Lord GOD, [You are] my confidence from my youth.
verses.textZh: 主─耶和華啊，你是我所盼望的；從我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。

verses.text: By You I have been sustained from [my] birth; You are He who took me from my mother's womb; My praise is continually of You.
verses.textZh: 我從出母胎被你扶持；使我出母腹的是你。我必常常讚美你！

verses.text: I have become a marvel to many, For You are my strong refuge.
verses.textZh: 許多人以我為怪，但你是我堅固的避難所。

verses.text: My mouth is filled with Your praise And with Your glory all day long.
verses.textZh: 你的讚美，你的榮耀終日必滿了我的口。

verses.text: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; Do not forsake me when my strength fails.
verses.textZh: 我年老的時候，求你不要丟棄我！我力氣衰弱的時候，求你不要離棄我！

verses.text: For my enemies have spoken against me; And those who watch for my life have consulted together,
verses.textZh: 我的仇敵議論我；那些窺探要害我命的彼此商議，

verses.text: Saying, 'God has forsaken him; Pursue and seize him, for there is no one to deliver.'
verses.textZh: 說：神已經離棄他；我們追趕他，捉拿他罷！因為沒有人搭救。

verses.text: O God, do not be far from me; O my God, hasten to my help!
verses.textZh: 神啊，求你不要遠離我！我的神啊，求你速速幫助我！

verses.text: Let those who are adversaries of my soul be ashamed [and] consumed; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor, who seek to injure me.
verses.textZh: 願那與我性命為敵的，羞愧被滅；願那謀害我的，受辱蒙羞。

verses.text: But as for me, I will hope continually, And will praise You yet more and more.
verses.textZh: 我卻要常常盼望，並要越發讚美你。

verses.text: My mouth shall tell of Your righteousness [And] of Your salvation all day long; For I do not know the sum [of them].
verses.textZh: 我的口終日要述說你的公義和你的救恩，因我不計其數。

verses.text: I will come with the mighty deeds of the Lord GOD; I will make mention of Your righteousness, Yours alone.
verses.textZh: 我要來說主─耶和華大能的事；我單要提說你的公義。

verses.text: O God, You have taught me from my youth, And I still declare Your wondrous deeds.
verses.textZh: 神啊，自我年幼時，你就教訓我；直到如今，我傳揚你奇妙的作為。

verses.text: And even when [I am] old and gray, O God, do not forsake me, Until I declare Your strength to [this] generation, Your power to all who are to come.
verses.textZh: 神啊，我到年老髮白的時候，求你不要離棄我！等我將你的能力指示下代，將你的大能指示後世的人。

verses.text: For Your righteousness, O God, [reaches] to the heavens, You who have done great things; O God, who is like You?
verses.textZh: 神啊，你的公義甚高；行過大事的神啊，誰能像你！

verses.text: You who have shown me many troubles and distresses Will revive me again, And will bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.textZh: 你是叫我們多經歷重大急難的，必使我們復活，從地的深處救上來。

verses.text: May You increase my greatness And turn [to] comfort me.
verses.textZh: 求你使我越發昌大，又轉來安慰我。

verses.text: I will also praise You with a harp, [Even] Your truth, O my God; To You I will sing praises with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
verses.textZh: 我的神啊，我要鼓瑟稱讚你，稱讚你的誠實！以色列的聖者啊，我要彈琴歌頌你！

verses.text: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praises to You; And my soul, which You have redeemed.
verses.textZh: 我歌頌你的時候，我的嘴唇和你所贖我的靈魂都必歡呼；

verses.text: My tongue also will utter Your righteousness all day long; For they are ashamed, for they are humiliated who seek my hurt.
verses.textZh: 並且我的舌頭必終日講論你的公義，因為那些謀害我的人已經蒙羞受辱了。
